instruction.text: Select the light switch to switch off the light.

b: ++Its stems have grown longer towards the window and it has grown paler.
The plant has grown straight up and with many flowers.
++The plant lost its light source and is looking for a new one.
This is the way this particular plant grows.

end.text: Plants are resourceful! When growing in a dark place, plants will grow towards a distant light source. This plant doesn’t have enough light, which causes it to lose its green colour and turn pale.

instruction.text: Drag the flower to the table in front of the window.

b: ++The flower is drooping because it received too much light.
The flower received too much light and has grown twice the size.
++The flower doesn’t need so much light.
The flower couldn’t sleep because it was too bright.

end.text: All plants need light but in different amounts. By moving the flower in front of the window and into direct sunlight, it received too much and shrivelled up. Just like us, plants can also be burnt by the sun.

instruction.text: Drag the watering can to water the sunflower on the left.
instruction.sound: Drag the watering-can to water the sunflower on the left.

b: ++One sunflower died.
The sunflowers grew too close together.
++The dead sunflower didn’t receive enough water.
The dead sunflower received too much water.

end.text: All living things need water to survive. By only giving water to the sunflower on the left, the right sunflower dried out in the hot sun.

instruction.text: Drag each source of water to the left, top, and right of this plant so that they are each giving it lots of water.

b: ++Its leaves are now drooping and have brown tips.
It is thriving.
++The plant received too much water.
The plant needed fertiliser.

end.text: Just like light, the correct amount of water is necessary for plants. Soil is important too. If a plant has the wrong soil it will hold too much water, which may cause the roots to rot.

instruction.text: Drag the plant to the shelf above the oven.

b: ++It shrivelled up and wilted.
It grew too large for the shelf.
++The heat above the oven was too warm.
The plant was being used for cooking.

end.text: If a plant is placed in an environment with the wrong temperature, it will not survive. Some plants and flowers may sprout early in spring only to freeze and die because of a later snowfall. This plant dried out because of the hot air above the oven.
